conclusion: Preliminary result at seed 7 on clean labels (outlier_fraction 0.0): OLS achieves lower MSE (0.17046895861013783) than the matched training-mean baseline (12.888358499556563). This is a single-seed, single-metric preliminary observation only; no general scientific value is claimed.
limitations: Only seed 7 was run; seeds 19 and 31 were not executed.
Only mse was computed; mae and median_absolute_error were not computed.
Single seed and single metric provide no basis for generalization.
No statistical testing or uncertainty quantification was performed.
Results are specific to this task version and clean-label condition (outlier_fraction 0.0).
